message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which strips every character outside `a-z0-9`. Since `vendor/` is off-limits, I made the fix in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. `postSlug` now removes accents before it calls `slugify`.

Shop product URLs in `src/shop/product-url.js` call the vendored `slugify` directly, so they will still drop accented letters. I left them alone because you only asked about blog posts. The cleaner long-term fix is an upgrade of the vendored `slugify` by the platform team.
